title: Master of Science in Data Science and Engineering
institution: Hamad Bin Khalifa University (HBKU), College of Science and Engineering
about: HBKU's Master of Science in Data Science and Engineering is a 33-credit programme taking about two years. Graduate applications opened 1 October 2026; the deadline for international applicants is 1 February 2027.
requirements: Bachelor's degree in computer science, information systems, engineering, mathematics or a related field
Minimum GPA 3.0 out of 4.0 (College of Science and Engineering)
International applicants: deadline 1 February 2027; Qatari and resident applicants seeking funding: 15 March 2027
Up to two applications per academic year

upskill.name: Big Data Engineering & Processing I
why: Field "Data science and engineering" → objective "Understand distributed data processing with Hadoop MapReduce, Apache Spark, and Flink for analytical workloads that exceed the capacity of a single machine."

Requirement "Bachelor's degree in computer science, information systems, engineering, mathematics or a related field" → objective "Relate batch, streaming, and orchestration patterns to the latency, scale, reliability, and operational requirements of analytics systems."
